##### Project general facts

Damac Hills 2 – Hotel Edge by Rotana is a modern hospitality development located within the growing DAMAC Hills 2 community in Dubai. Managed by the internationally recognized Edge by Rotana brand, the project is designed as a contemporary three-star hotel offering both hospitality services and investment opportunities. Positioned within a large master-planned residential community, the hotel combines modern accommodation with access to a wide variety of lifestyle and entertainment attractions, creating an appealing destination for both visitors and investors.

The project benefits from its location inside DAMAC Hills 2, where residents and guests have access to numerous recreational amenities including Malibu Beach wave pool, sports fields, outdoor cinema, paintball arcade, butterfly garden, and other community leisure facilities. As one of the few hospitality developments in the area, the hotel offers a unique investment proposition supported by the continuous growth of the surrounding community and Dubai’s expanding tourism sector. The overall concept emphasizes convenience, accessibility, and a comfortable resort-style experience within a vibrant suburban environment.

The interiors feature bright and stylish contemporary décor designed to create a comfortable hotel atmosphere. The apartments do not include kitchens, reflecting the project’s hospitality-oriented concept. All units are fully furnished with classic modern furniture and include work desks, bathrooms with walk-in showers or bathtubs, smart in-room technology, high-speed Wi-Fi, minibar fridge, 55-inch LED TV, tea and coffee facilities, bottled water, hairdryer, safety box, and additional hospitality features designed to meet international hotel standards.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills is a prestigious residential community located in the heart of Dubai. Nestled within lush green landscapes and offering a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, this development is a testament to modern urban living.

Residents of Damac Hills have access to a wealth of amenities, including world-class golf courses, fitness centers, swimming pools, and lush parks. The community is designed to provide a holistic living experience where leisure and well-being are paramount.

Situated in close proximity to major road networks, Damac Hills offers easy access to the city's key destinations, including business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs. This central location enhances the overall convenience of living in this vibrant community.
